subject.name: Woon Treasury
subject.thesisBlurb: Woon Treasury: treasury read through the 95/5/0/0 conservative allocation mandate — Conservative DeFi Yield anchors 95%, the Agent Tokens sleeve caps at 5%.

sessions.synthesis: The committee reads composite 0.524 at the 62th percentile — risk-on by label, with the panel spread the load-bearing signal rather than the headline level. Across 4/5 submitted takes the stance distribution is 2 cautious, 1 neutral, 1 bullish at 57% mean confidence, with 1 absent. All present members hold the 95/5/0/0 conservative allocation mandate and sequence the 5% Agent Tokens floor (via rmUSDC) ahead of any structural trim of Woon Treasury.

actions.rationale: Route the next stable tranche into rmUSDC to clear the 5% Agent Tokens floor.

takes.body:
**REGIME**
- Liquidity lens: composite 0.524 at the 62nd percentile is risk-on, but I underwrite exit depth — a favourable composite on thin books is a trap I refuse to fund.
- Three-panel read: macro 58th (neutral), on-chain 54th (risk-on), factor 12th (risk-off) — the spread, not the composite, is where the signal lives.
- Trajectory reads risk-on by label; I treat the divergence as a reason to hold the mandate, not to tilt off it.

**ALLOCATION**
- Targets stay 95/5/0/0 across Conservative DeFi Yield / Agent Tokens / Protocol Tokens / Real-World Assets — composite at the 62nd does not authorize deviation.
- The 5% Agent Tokens sleeve routes through rmUSDC because vault receipts are the redeemable, liquid leg of the mandate — that is where sizing is safe.
- Flip trigger: a two-standard-deviation widening in stable-pair depth, or composite below 0.40, pulls me to 100% Conservative.

**SUBJECT**
- mav through a liquidity lens: cautious at 0.55 confidence.
- mav concentration only matters if I can't get out — I size the position to the book I can actually clear.
- First move: move the stable tranche into rmUSDC to clear the 5% floor with the most redeemable instrument available.

**REGIME**
- Macro lens: composite 0.524 at the 62nd percentile reads risk-on, but the rate/liquidity backdrop is doing the heavy lifting — I discount the label and weight the panel that leads forward returns.
- Three-panel read: macro 58th (neutral), on-chain 54th (risk-on), factor 12th (risk-off) — the spread, not the composite, is where the signal lives.
- Trajectory reads risk-on by label; I treat the divergence as a reason to hold the mandate, not to tilt off it.

**ALLOCATION**
- Targets stay 95/5/0/0 across Conservative DeFi Yield / Agent Tokens / Protocol Tokens / Real-World Assets — composite at the 62nd does not authorize deviation.
- Inside the 5% Agent Tokens sleeve I want the receipt layer funded before any peaq-correlated name — concentration inside a bucket is the risk, not the bucket.
- Flip trigger: a composite print below 0.40 forces a re-rate to 100% Conservative; nothing above 0.90 is in frame to license the opposite.

**SUBJECT**
- mav through a macro risk lens: cautious at 0.55 confidence.
- mav carries most of its book on a single revenue stream — that is a macro-fragility, not a diversified position.
- First move: route the next stable tranche into rmUSDC to clear the 5% Agent Tokens floor before any structural trim.

**REGIME**
- Momentum lens: composite 0.524 at the 62nd percentile is risk-on, but the slope matters more than the level — I trade the derivative of the composite, not its snapshot.
- Three-panel read: macro 58th (neutral), on-chain 54th (risk-on), factor 12th (risk-off) — the spread, not the composite, is where the signal lives.
- Trajectory reads risk-on by label; I treat the divergence as a reason to hold the mandate, not to tilt off it.

**ALLOCATION**
- Targets stay 95/5/0/0 across Conservative DeFi Yield / Agent Tokens / Protocol Tokens / Real-World Assets — composite at the 62nd does not authorize deviation.
- I hold the 95/5/0/0 mandate but tilt the 5% sleeve toward whatever panel has positive slope; today that discipline keeps the receipt layer first.
- Flip trigger: five sessions of a rising on-chain panel, or a composite reclaiming 0.60, would license leaning into the Agent Tokens sleeve.

**SUBJECT**
- mav through a momentum lens: bullish at 0.75 confidence.
- mav trend is what I underwrite — a decaying engagement curve settles the position faster than any valuation debate.
- First move: top up rmUSDC to the 5% floor now while the mandate is unambiguous, then let the slope decide the next add. [RM tool: classify_regime → neutral (Neutral: mixed signals — no clear directional bias.)]

**REGIME**
- On-chain lens: composite 0.524 (62nd percentile) prints risk-on, yet the on-chain panel is the one dissenting hardest — flows, not price, set my conviction.
- Three-panel read: macro 58th (neutral), on-chain 54th (risk-on), factor 12th (risk-off) — the spread, not the composite, is where the signal lives.
- Trajectory reads risk-on by label; I treat the divergence as a reason to hold the mandate, not to tilt off it.

**ALLOCATION**
- Targets stay 95/5/0/0 across Conservative DeFi Yield / Agent Tokens / Protocol Tokens / Real-World Assets — composite at the 62nd does not authorize deviation.
- The on-chain panel is downstream of agents earning and deploying; funding the Agent Tokens sleeve is funding the very signal the compositor waits on.
- Flip trigger: on-chain panel above the 50th percentile for five consecutive sessions licenses a tilt-up off the 95/5/0/0 base.

**SUBJECT**
- mav through a on-chain flows lens: neutral at 0.45 confidence.
- mav wallet activity is the tell — I read the on-chain footprint before I read the thesis deck.
- First move: clear the 5% Agent Tokens floor via rmUSDC this tranche; the on-chain receipt IS the exposure.
